scientific_integrity: Normalizations and boundary cases are explicit; numerical checks are supplementary to a full proof; no independent audit is asserted.
scientific_limitations: The exact norm covers two affine cosets in finite abelian groups. Unequal-ratio asymptotics hold for fixed ratio less than one and are not uniform at the diagonal. Older unindexed polygon-average or coset-union identities may exist.
title: Exact Fourier-algebra norm of two affine cosets and its parity-ordered quotient law
